sn34.1:1.4: idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo.
sn34.1:1.5: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo.
sn34.1:1.6: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī neva samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo.
sn34.1:1.7: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca.
sn34.1:1.8: tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca. ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca.
sn34.1:1.9: seyyathāpi bhikkhave gavā khīraṃ khīramhā dadhi dadhimhā navanītaṃ navanītamhā sappi sappimhā sappimaṇḍo tatra aggamakkhāyati
sn34.1:1.10: evameva kho bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca. ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro cāti.
